arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near critical power (pod about 145-155 W) after the hard start, keep pod reserve above about 30 pct until the last 1.5 km, then spend it: push from about 1500 m to go, finish sprint from about 400 m. Ease if pod reserve falls fast mid-race; push if reserve stays high and power sits well below CP. Watch for incidents: rudder weed (speed drops with power steady, push_local falls), pod drift (pod vs boat-model power diverge), radio course changes (set_race_distance and tell). Compare same-direction legs with legs().
